# Bazel test targets the rust_test job in .github/workflows/sami-build.yml runs
# as root: a second `bazel test` with --run_under="sudo -E". Each must be tagged
# no-sandbox, since linux-sandbox maps a single uid. The job fails when a test
# in one of them prints `not run:`, since root is its precondition.
# One per line: <bazel test target>  <why it needs root>.
